t: You're at a skatepark in London, named after Ben Raemers. Ben was a British professional skateboarder who lived from 1990 to 2019, and he's been described as one of the greatest British skateboarders. That's why a place for skating carries his name: it honours someone who made his mark on the sport. The material I have doesn't go further, so I'll let the park speak for itself, the sound of wheels and boards.
